_comment: One row per (province, year, track) page carrying a provincial parallel-
volunteer filing table for the first undergraduate batch. Compiled by hand.
`verified` is set only for a URL that was fetched and seen to carry the
table; every other row is a candidate. The parser refuses to sweep an
unverified row, because a page that answers with something else would be
recorded as a province with a short list rather than as a wrong page.
`track` is `science`, `arts`, or `both` when one page carries both.
Cross-check that licences this source: Sina's Henan 2016 science table gives
Tsinghua 685, and Tsinghua's own admissions site gives 685 for Henan 2016
science. Two independent publications, one number, exact agreement.

43 candidates added 2026-08-27 from a search pass run elsewhere. Every one carries verified:false until it has been fetched and seen. A candidate list is a list of things to check, and an article id is exactly the kind of string that reads as real whether or not it is.

The 2015 rows come from one Sina hub page listing every province's tables, which is a far better object than a list of individual urls: if such a hub exists for 2015 it very likely exists for 2014 and 2016.

`quantity` separates three things that must not share a column: `filing` is the score at which files are released, `filing_rank` is that plus a published rank, and `admitted_min` is the lowest score actually admitted, which some provinces publish instead. Within one province either supports an ordering, but one province must not be read on one basis in one year and the other in the next.
`tier` records a subdivision inside the first batch, since several provinces split it into lettered tiers or volunteer groups and only the main one is taken.

Excluded from the same hub and named so the exclusions are auditable: every supplementary round, every arts, sports, music and fine-art table, the early batch, the simulated filing runs, and a page covering six institutions.

31 candidate urls answered 404 and were removed. They came from a search pass run elsewhere and an article identifier is exactly the kind of string that reads as real whether or not it is; the count is kept here because it is the finding, and the urls are not because they point at nothing.
Reconciled 2026-08-27 against the directory and against the panel, by
`data/gaokao_sources.json`'s own reconciliation step. Two fields are
derived and are rewritten on each run rather than maintained by hand:
`on_disk` is the file stem holding this page or false, and `in_panel` is
whether any row in `data/gaokao_provincial.csv` came from it.
A row can be on disk and out of the panel for two stated reasons, and
both are printed by the parser rather than assumed. The page carries no
article body, which is five provinces here; or its own title says it is a
supplementary round, which is three pages.
The fetcher wrote every page twice, once under `<province>_<year>_<track>`
and once under `<province>_<year>`, so the directory holds more files than
there are pages. The loader passes over the duplicates by content hash and
names the ones it skipped. Nothing was removed from disk.
